aborted: operator abort: host free space fell below 3 GB (df -h: 2.2 GiB) during the generator-validation phase, after COPY and the index rebuild had finished

observed.note: the loader at that time checked free space only during COPY and before each index build; it was killed (exit 137) and the database dropped. load.py now checks every phase and runs a watchdog that cancels the running statement below 3 GB.
